''; const specs = Array.isArray(base.visible_projection_specs) ? base.visible_projection_specs : []; const ranges = specs.map((spec) => `ranges=${encodeURIComponent(`${spec.sheet_title}!1:1`)}`).join('&'); return `https://sheets.googleapis.com/v4/spreadsheets/${googleSheetId}?includeGridData=true&fields=sheets(properties(sheetId,title),data(rowData(values(formattedValue))))${ranges ? `&${ranges}` : ''}`; })() }}

parameters.content:
## 1. Source Resolution
Resolve publics from payload or `sources_config` + `source_state`.
Start here when the run picks the wrong sources.

## 2. Fetch
Build target jobs, run the Telegram helper, parse helper envelopes, aggregate raw posts.
Start here for target lookup or fetch failures.

## 3. Extract
Deterministic extract helper turns raw posts into structured posts.

## 4. Merge
Deterministic merge canonicalizes providers and offers before any LLM work.

## 5. LLM
Optional post-merge review and categorization.
Bypass remains valid when `llm_enabled=false`.

## 6. Sheets Publication
Build projection rows, then upsert `service_runs`, `catalog`, `source_*`, and visibility tweaks.
Catalog writes are upper lane; source-tab writes continue further right.

## 7. Webhook Response
Final HTTP body is assembled here and must end in `Respond to Webhook`.

parameters.url: ={{ `https://sheets.googleapis.com/v4/spreadsheets/${$('WF-SHEETS-04 Build Projection Rows (v1)').first().json.sheets_config?.google_sheet_id ?? ''}/values/${encodeURIComponent($('WF-SHEETS-04 Emit Visible Services Rows (v1)').first().json.visible_services_sheet_write_range ?? '')}?valueInputOption=RAW` }}
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ range: $('WF-SHEETS-04 Emit Visible Services Rows (v1)').first().json.visible_services_sheet_write_range ?? '', majorDimension: 'ROWS', values: $('WF-SHEETS-04 Emit Visible Services Rows (v1)').first().json.visible_services_sheet_write_matrix ?? [] }) }}
